signal: Merge scaled its unified-API integration platform to roughly 141 employees, expanding HR, CRM, and ATS integration coverage across more software customers

email.body1:
Eric, saw Merge scaling the unified-API platform and headcount as integration demand grows.

Growth like that usually exposes signal-to-action latency: in-market accounts surface faster than the team can act on them, and data hygiene around handoffs slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a signal play for Merge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Eric, quick follow-up for Merge.

From a RevOps and CS seat, the lift usually hides in how fast signals turn into a sent, personalized touch, and in the data behind it. Small process changes there compound across every account.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Eric, last bit of proof for Merge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Merge's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B API startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Eric, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know RevOps roadmaps fill up fast and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your stack? I will tailor it to Merge either way.
